blocks.en: 5.1.1 Introduction

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Life Cycle Cost（生命週期成本）：不只是採購價格，還包括安裝、運轉能耗、維護保養、停機損失到最終報廢的全部成本。ISPE 在這裡開宗明義告訴我們：HVAC 設備選型的核心判斷標準是「全生命週期成本最優」，而非「初始採購價格最低」。
blocks.en: Life Cycle Cost: Not just the purchase price, but the total cost from installation, operating energy, maintenance and downtime losses through to final disposal. ISPE states up front that the core criterion for HVAC equipment selection is "lowest total life cycle cost", not "lowest initial purchase price".

blocks.zh: Conditioned Air（調節空氣）：經過溫度、濕度、潔淨度控制的空氣，是 GMP 環境的基本保障。
blocks.en: Conditioned Air: Air whose temperature, humidity and cleanliness are controlled; it is the basic safeguard of a GMP environment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 就像買車一樣——一台便宜的車如果油耗高、常常拋錨，長期來看反而更貴。HVAC 設備也是如此：初期多投資在品質上，可以換來更低的能耗、更少的停機維修、更長的使用壽命。這就是 TCO（總擁有成本）的思維方式。
blocks.en: It is like buying a car: a cheap car with high fuel consumption that breaks down often ends up costing more in the long run. HVAC equipment is the same: investing more in quality up front buys lower energy use, less downtime and repair, and a longer service life. This is the TCO (total cost of ownership) way of thinking.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別提到「off the shelf」設備在某些情況下也可以接受——這代表 GMP 不等於一定要用最貴的「製藥專用」設備。關鍵是進行經濟分析（Economic Analysis），證明所選設備能滿足 User Requirements。這是一種風險導向（Risk-based）的務實態度。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically notes that "off the shelf" equipment can be acceptable in some cases. This means GMP does not necessarily require the most expensive "pharma-specific" equipment. What matters is performing an economic analysis to show that the selected equipment meets the User Requirements. This is a pragmatic, risk-based attitude.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的工廠在採購 HVAC 設備時，是否有進行全生命週期成本分析？還是只看報價單上的數字？
blocks.en: When your site purchases HVAC equipment, does it perform a life cycle cost analysis, or does it look only at the figures on the quotation?

blocks.zh: 「Off the shelf」設備在你的廠區中使用的比例有多高？使用經驗如何？
blocks.en: What proportion of the equipment at your site is "off the shelf", and what has your experience with it been?

blocks.zh: 5.1.2 Air Handler Unit（空氣處理機組）
blocks.en: 5.1.2 Air Handler Unit

blocks.zh: 核心概念：AHU 設計哲學
blocks.en: Key Concept: AHU Design Philosophy

blocks.zh: AHU（Air Handler Unit，空氣處理機組）：HVAC 系統的心臟，負責將空氣經過過濾、加熱/冷卻、加濕/除濕後送入潔淨空間。ISPE 在此強調一個重要觀念：「pharma grade」和「off-the-shelf」都可能符合 GMP，選擇取決於經濟分析，而非品牌標籤。
blocks.en: AHU (Air Handler Unit): The heart of the HVAC system. It filters, heats/cools and humidifies/dehumidifies air before supplying it to the clean spaces. ISPE stresses an important point here: both "pharma grade" and "off-the-shelf" units can comply with GMP, and the choice depends on economic analysis, not on brand labels.

blocks.zh: 115% 設計容量：所有組件預留 15% 的餘裕容量，這是一個黃金法則。因為系統老化、濾網壓損增加、未來產能擴張都會消耗這個餘量。沒有餘量的系統，投產第一天就在「極限」運轉。
blocks.en: 115% design capacity: Every component is given 15% spare capacity, a golden rule. Ageing of the system, rising filter pressure drop and future capacity expansion will all consume this margin. A system with no margin is running at its limit from the first day of production.

blocks.zh: Thermal Break（隔熱斷橋）：在潮濕地區，AHU 箱體外部會結露。隔熱斷橋切斷金屬的熱傳導路徑，防止內外溫差導致的凝結。
blocks.en: Thermal Break: In humid regions, condensation forms on the outside of the AHU casing. A thermal break interrupts the conductive path through the metal and prevents condensation caused by the temperature difference between inside and outside.

blocks.zh: AHU 就像一棟「空氣工廠」——每個隔間（section）都有專門功能：混合間（Mixing Plenum）像食材備料區、冷卻盤管像冰箱、加熱盤管像烤箱、加濕器像蒸氣鍋、風扇像傳送帶。整個箱體就是這座工廠的外殼，必須密封、保溫、耐腐蝕、易維護。115% 容量就像餐廳座位不會剛好等於客人數，一定要預留彈性。
blocks.en: An AHU is like an "air factory", with each section serving a specific function: the mixing plenum is the food preparation area, the cooling coil is the refrigerator, the heating coil is the oven, the humidifier is the steamer, and the fan is the conveyor belt. The casing as a whole is the shell of this factory and must be sealed, insulated, corrosion-resistant and easy to maintain. The 115% capacity is like a restaurant that never has exactly as many seats as guests: some flexibility must always be kept in reserve.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：材料與防腐
blocks.en: Key Notes: Materials and Corrosion Protection

blocks.zh: 注意材料規格的層次感：
blocks.en: Note the layers in the material specification:

blocks.zh: 一般區域：鍍鋅鋼板（galvanized steel）或鋁材
blocks.en: General areas: galvanized steel or aluminum

blocks.zh: 冷卻盤管/蒸汽加濕段：必須用 304L 不鏽鋼，因為這些區段長期高濕度
blocks.en: Cooling coil / steam humidifier sections: must be 304L stainless steel, because these sections are exposed to high humidity over long periods

blocks.zh: 五金件：300 系列不鏽鋼，連螺絲都不能生鏽
blocks.en: Hardware: 300-series stainless steel; even the screws must not rust

blocks.zh: 密封膠：食品級 RTV 矽膠（內部）、25 年壽命防黴膠（外部）
blocks.en: Sealant: food-grade RTV silicone (internal), mildew-resistant sealant with a 25-year life (external)

blocks.zh: 這些細節看似瑣碎，但在台灣高溫高濕的環境下，如果忽略防腐設計，AHU 可能三年就開始鏽蝕滲漏。
blocks.en: These details may look trivial, but in the hot and humid climate of Taiwan, if corrosion protection is neglected an AHU can start to rust and leak in as little as three years.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：門的設計邏輯
blocks.en: Key Notes: Door Design Logic

blocks.zh: 門必須「逆壓開啟」——向著高壓方向打開。這樣做有兩個好處：
blocks.en: Doors must open against the pressure, that is, toward the high-pressure side. This has two benefits:

blocks.zh: 安全性：正壓段的門若順壓開，可能會被氣壓彈開傷人
blocks.en: Safety: A door in a positive-pressure section that opens with the pressure could be blown open and injure someone

blocks.zh: 密封性：正壓幫助門密合，減少洩漏
blocks.en: Sealing: Positive pressure helps hold the door closed and reduces leakage

blocks.zh: 另外，門內側必須裝把手——防止維修人員被困在 AHU 裡面。這是人身安全的基本要求。
blocks.en: In addition, a handle must be fitted on the inside of the door to prevent maintenance personnel from being trapped inside the AHU. This is a basic personnel safety requirement.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在台灣與東南亞的 CDMO 廠房，高濕度環境使得 AHU 外箱凝結特別嚴重。實務上建議：（1）採用隔熱斷橋結構；（2）排水盤一律使用 304L SS；（3）定期檢查密封膠是否劣化。許多工廠忽略這些「小細節」，結果幾年後箱體發霉、管路鏽蝕，維修成本遠超過當初省下的建設費用。
blocks.en: In CDMO facilities in Taiwan and Southeast Asia, the high humidity makes condensation on the outside of the AHU casing especially severe. In practice we recommend: (1) use a thermal break construction; (2) always use 304L SS for drain pans; (3) inspect regularly for sealant deterioration. Many plants overlook these "small details", and a few years later the casing is moldy and the piping corroded, with repair costs far exceeding the construction savings made originally.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 AHU 箱體是否有隔熱斷橋設計？在高濕度季節是否有外部凝結問題？
blocks.en: Does your plant's AHU casing have a thermal break design? Do you have external condensation problems in the humid season?

blocks.zh: 排水盤的材質和坡度是否符合本節建議？是否曾發生過積水或微生物滋生？
blocks.en: Do the drain pan material and slope meet the recommendations in this section? Has there ever been standing water or microbial growth?

blocks.zh: AHU 門的開啟方向是否正確（逆壓開啟）？觀察窗是否清晰可用？
blocks.en: Do the AHU doors open in the correct direction (against the pressure)? Are the view ports clear and usable?

blocks.zh: 5.1.3 Fans（風扇）
blocks.en: 5.1.3 Fans

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風扇類型與選型邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concept: Fan Types and Selection Logic

blocks.zh: Draw-through（抽吸式）vs Blow-through（吹送式）：
blocks.en: Draw-through vs Blow-through:

blocks.zh: Draw-through：風扇在盤管/濾網下游，「把空氣吸過」處理元件。優點：箱體較短、大部分段為負壓（門不易被吹開）、風扇散熱可減少再加熱需求
blocks.en: Draw-through: The fan is downstream of the coils/filters and "pulls air through" the treatment components. Advantages: shorter casing, most sections under negative pressure (doors are less likely to be blown open), and fan heat can reduce the reheat requirement

blocks.zh: Blow-through：風扇在上游，「把空氣推過」處理元件。較少使用
blocks.en: Blow-through: The fan is upstream and "pushes air through" the treatment components. Less commonly used

blocks.zh: Fan Wall（風扇牆）：用多台小風扇並聯取代一台大風扇。這是近年的趨勢技術——降低噪音、縮小占地、提供冗餘、簡化維護。即使一台故障，其他風扇可以繼續運轉。
blocks.en: Fan Wall: Multiple small fans in parallel replace one large fan. This is a recent trend: it lowers noise, reduces footprint, provides redundancy and simplifies maintenance. Even if one fan fails, the others can keep running.

blocks.zh: AMCA Class II/III：製藥業通常使用 Class II 或 III，代表中等到較高的機械強度。Class I 太弱，Class IV 通常過度設計。
blocks.en: AMCA Class II/III: The pharmaceutical industry typically uses Class II or III, meaning moderate to high mechanical strength. Class I is too weak, and Class IV is usually over-designed.

blocks.zh: 風扇就像心臟，驅動著整個 HVAC 系統的「血液循環」。Draw-through 就像用吸管喝飲料（吸力在下游），Blow-through 就像用嘴吹泡泡（推力在上游）。Fan Wall 則像把一顆大心臟換成多顆小心臟並聯——其中一顆暫停，其他還能維持循環，這就是冗餘（redundancy）的價值。
blocks.en: The fan is like a heart, driving the "blood circulation" of the whole HVAC system. Draw-through is like drinking through a straw (suction downstream), and blow-through is like blowing bubbles (push upstream). A fan wall is like replacing one big heart with several small hearts in parallel: if one pauses, the others can still keep circulation going. That is the value of redundancy.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：軸承是最大故障點
blocks.en: Key Notes: Bearings Are the Biggest Point of Failure

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：「Bearing failure is the most common failure encountered within air handlers.」這句話非常重要。軸承壽命管理是 AHU 可靠性的核心：
blocks.en: ISPE states explicitly: "Bearing failure is the most common failure encountered within air handlers." This sentence is very important. Bearing life management is at the core of AHU reliability:

blocks.zh: 風扇軸承：ABMA L10 ≥ 200,000 小時（約 22.8 年連續運轉）
blocks.en: Fan bearings: ABMA L10 ≥ 200,000 hours (about 22.8 years of continuous operation)

blocks.zh: 馬達軸承：ABMA L10 ≥ 100,000 小時（見 5.1.4 節）
blocks.en: Motor bearings: ABMA L10 ≥ 100,000 hours (see section 5.1.4)

blocks.zh: 自動潤滑器：至少 6 個月免補充，安裝在軸承座上
blocks.en: Automatic lubricators: at least 6 months without refilling, mounted on the bearing housing

blocks.zh: 振動監測：BV-4 等級，三軸向電子檢測
blocks.en: Vibration monitoring: BV-4 grade, electronic detection in three axes

blocks.zh: 轉速不應超過 1800 RPM——過高會縮短軸承壽命並產生危險振動。
blocks.en: Speed should not exceed 1800 RPM: higher speeds shorten bearing life and produce dangerous vibration.

blocks.zh: 風扇關鍵規格 Fan Specifications
blocks.en: Key Fan Specifications

blocks.zh:
風扇軸承壽命：ABMA L10 ≥ 200,000 小時
馬達軸承壽命：ABMA L10 ≥ 100,000 小時
臨界轉速餘量：第一臨界速度 ≥ 最大運轉速度 × 125%
最大轉速建議：≤ 1,800 RPM
振動等級：ANSI/AMCA 204-05, BV-4
自動潤滑器補充週期：≥ 6 個月
blocks.en:
Fan bearing life: ABMA L10 ≥ 200,000 hours
Motor bearing life: ABMA L10 ≥ 100,000 hours
Critical speed margin: first critical speed ≥ maximum operating speed × 125%
Recommended maximum speed: ≤ 1,800 RPM
Vibration grade: ANSI/AMCA 204-05, BV-4
Automatic lubricator refill interval: ≥ 6 months

blocks.zh: 重點提示：皮帶 vs 直驅
blocks.en: Key Notes: Belt Drive vs Direct Drive

blocks.zh: 直驅（Direct Drive）優勢明顯：
blocks.en: Direct drive has clear advantages:

blocks.zh: 免更換皮帶、免皮帶防護罩、免對心校正
blocks.en: No belt replacement, no belt guard, no alignment

blocks.zh: 無軸封軸承 = 免潤滑維護
blocks.en: Sealed bearings = lubrication-free maintenance

blocks.zh: 搭配 VFD 可精確調速
blocks.en: Combined with a VFD, speed can be adjusted precisely

blocks.zh: 皮帶驅動（Belt Drive）的注意事項：
blocks.en: Points to note for belt drive:

blocks.zh: 新皮帶磨合後需重新調整張力
blocks.en: Belt tension must be readjusted after a new belt has run in

blocks.zh: 張力不足 → 打滑 → 提前失效 + 浪費能源
blocks.en: Insufficient tension → slippage → early failure + wasted energy

blocks.zh: 張力過大 → 軸承壽命縮短
blocks.en: Excessive tension → shortened bearing life

blocks.zh: 同步皮帶（Synchronous Belt）不打滑，省電
blocks.en: Synchronous belts do not slip and save energy

blocks.zh: 雷射校準可延長皮帶、軸承和軸的壽命
blocks.en: Laser alignment can extend the life of belts, bearings and shafts

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 廠房中，AHU 停機直接影響潔淨室的壓差和潔淨度——這意味著生產線被迫停線。因此，Fan Wall 設計在高可靠度需求的製藥廠越來越受歡迎。此外，建議在關鍵 AHU 上安裝振動感測器並接入 BMS（Building Management System），實現軸承狀態的即時監控和趨勢分析，在軸承完全失效前就進行預防性維護。
blocks.en: In a CDMO facility, AHU downtime directly affects the pressure differential and cleanliness of the cleanrooms, which forces production lines to stop. For this reason, fan wall designs are increasingly popular in pharmaceutical plants with high reliability requirements. We also recommend installing vibration sensors on critical AHUs and connecting them to the BMS (Building Management System), so that bearing condition can be monitored in real time and trended, allowing preventive maintenance before the bearing fails completely.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 AHU 是 draw-through 還是 blow-through 配置？為什麼？
blocks.en: Is your plant's AHU a draw-through or blow-through configuration, and why?

blocks.zh: 目前是否有使用 Fan Wall 設計？如果沒有，在哪些應用場景下值得考慮？
blocks.en: Do you currently use a fan wall design? If not, in which applications would it be worth considering?

blocks.zh: 風扇軸承是否有安裝自動潤滑器？振動監測數據是否接入 BMS？
blocks.en: Are the fan bearings fitted with automatic lubricators? Is the vibration monitoring data connected to the BMS?

blocks.zh: 5.1.4 Motors and Drives（馬達與驅動器）
blocks.en: 5.1.4 Motors and Drives

blocks.zh: 核心概念：VFD 是現代 HVAC 的標配
blocks.en: Key Concept: The VFD Is Standard in Modern HVAC

blocks.zh: VFD（Variable Frequency Drive，變頻器）：透過改變供電頻率來調節馬達轉速，從而精確控制風量。相比傳統的入口導葉（Variable Inlet Guide Vanes），VFD 是全方位的升級：
blocks.en: VFD (Variable Frequency Drive): Regulates motor speed by changing the supply frequency, and thereby controls airflow precisely. Compared with traditional variable inlet guide vanes, the VFD is an all-round upgrade:

blocks.zh: 節能效果顯著——風量減少 20%，功耗可降低約 50%（風扇定律：功率 ∝ 轉速³）
blocks.en: Significant energy saving: a 20% reduction in airflow can cut power consumption by about 50% (fan law: power ∝ speed³)

blocks.zh: 軟啟動（Soft Start）減少電流衝擊和機械應力
blocks.en: Soft start reduces current surge and mechanical stress

blocks.zh: 可直接與 BAS（Building Automation System）整合
blocks.en: Can be integrated directly with the BAS (Building Automation System)

blocks.zh: Shaft Grounding（軸接地）：VFD 產生的高頻電流會透過軸承放電，導致「電蝕」（EDM, Electrical Discharge Machining）效應，嚴重時幾個月內就能損壞軸承。必須安裝軸接地環或使用絕緣軸承。
blocks.en: Shaft Grounding: The high-frequency current produced by a VFD discharges through the bearings, causing an "electrical erosion" effect (EDM, Electrical Discharge Machining), which in severe cases can destroy a bearing within a few months. A shaft grounding ring or insulated bearings must be installed.

blocks.zh: VFD 就像汽車的油門——不用 VFD 的風扇就像只有「全開」和「關」兩個選項的電風扇，而用了 VFD 就變成無段變速。你不需要一直全速運轉再用擋板來阻擋多餘的風（這就是導葉的做法），而是直接讓風扇按需要的速度轉——既省電又安靜。
blocks.en: A VFD is like a car's accelerator. A fan without a VFD is like an electric fan with only "full on" and "off", whereas with a VFD it becomes infinitely variable. You do not need to run at full speed all the time and then block the surplus air with a damper (which is what inlet guide vanes do); instead the fan simply turns at the speed required, saving energy and running more quietly.

blocks.zh: 風扇定律 Fan Laws
blocks.en: Fan Laws

blocks.zh:
風量 Q ∝ 轉速 N
靜壓 P ∝ N²
功率 W ∝ N³

範例：風量降低 20%（N = 0.8）
功率 = 0.8³ = 0.512 → 節省約 49% 能耗

這就是 VFD 節能的數學基礎！
blocks.en:
Airflow Q ∝ speed N
Static pressure P ∝ N²
Power W ∝ N³

Example: airflow reduced by 20% (N = 0.8)
Power = 0.8³ = 0.512 → about 49% energy saving

This is the mathematical basis of VFD energy saving!

blocks.zh: 重點提示：VFD 引起的軸承電蝕
blocks.en: Key Notes: Bearing Electrical Erosion Caused by VFDs

blocks.zh: VFD 的高頻脈衝寬度調變（PWM）會在馬達軸上感應出電壓。如果這個電壓透過軸承放電，會在滾珠和滾道表面產生「凹坑」——就像微型閃電打在軸承上。解決方案：
blocks.en: The high-frequency pulse width modulation (PWM) of a VFD induces a voltage on the motor shaft. If this voltage discharges through the bearing, it creates "pits" on the surfaces of the balls and raceways, like tiny bolts of lightning striking the bearing. Solutions:

blocks.zh: 安裝軸接地環（如 AEGIS SGR）
blocks.en: Install a shaft grounding ring (such as AEGIS SGR)

blocks.zh: 使用陶瓷絕緣軸承
blocks.en: Use ceramic insulated bearings

blocks.zh: 加裝線端與負載端電抗器（Line and Load Reactors）
blocks.en: Add line-side and load-side reactors (Line and Load Reactors)

blocks.zh: 這是一個常被忽視但後果嚴重的問題——許多「不明原因」的軸承早期失效，其實就是 VFD 電蝕造成的。
blocks.en: This is an often overlooked problem with serious consequences: many "unexplained" early bearing failures are in fact caused by VFD electrical erosion.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 AHU 馬達是否全部配備 VFD？是否有使用「Inverter Duty」等級的馬達？
blocks.en: Are all the AHU motors at your plant fitted with VFDs? Do you use "Inverter Duty" rated motors?

blocks.zh: 是否安裝了軸接地環來防止 VFD 引起的電蝕？
blocks.en: Are shaft grounding rings installed to prevent VFD-induced electrical erosion?

blocks.zh: VFD 是否配備了線端和負載端電抗器？
blocks.en: Are the VFDs fitted with line-side and load-side reactors?

blocks.zh: 5.1.5 Electrical（電氣）
blocks.en: 5.1.5 Electrical

blocks.zh: 核心概念：AHU 內部電氣安全
blocks.en: Key Concept: Electrical Safety Inside the AHU

blocks.zh: 大型 AHU 箱體內部空間足以讓維修人員進入工作，因此電氣安全設計至關重要。重點包括：
blocks.en: The interior of a large AHU casing is big enough for maintenance personnel to enter and work in, so electrical safety design is critical. Key points include:

blocks.zh: 防水照明：氣密防水燈具，6 小時自動關閉定時器（防止忘記關燈浪費能源或產生安全風險）
blocks.en: Waterproof lighting: airtight, waterproof fixtures with a 6-hour automatic shut-off timer (to prevent lights being left on, wasting energy or creating a safety risk)

blocks.zh: 接線盒防水：管道穿孔處必須氣密封堵
blocks.en: Waterproof junction boxes: conduit penetrations must be sealed airtight

blocks.zh: 標識管理：所有電氣元件、接線端子都需標籤，高壓端子必須警示標記
blocks.en: Labeling: all electrical components and terminals must be labeled, and high-voltage terminals must carry warning markings

blocks.zh: 安全警告：風扇段門上貼「進入前先隔離」標誌
blocks.en: Safety warnings: a "Isolate before entry" sign on the fan section door

blocks.zh: 6 小時最大定時器是個容易被忽略的細節——維修人員進入 AHU 開燈後如果忘記關，定時器確保不會一直亮著。在潮濕的 AHU 內部，長時間亮燈不僅浪費能源，還可能因溫度升高影響局部環境。
blocks.en: The 6-hour maximum timer is an easily overlooked detail: if maintenance personnel switch on the light when entering the AHU and forget to switch it off, the timer ensures it does not stay on indefinitely. Inside a humid AHU, long periods of lighting not only waste energy but can also raise the local temperature and affect the local environment.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 AHU 內部是否有安裝固定照明？燈具是否為防水等級？
blocks.en: Is there fixed lighting inside your plant's AHUs? Are the fixtures waterproof rated?

blocks.zh: 風扇段的門上是否有「隔離後再進入」的安全標示？
blocks.en: Do the fan section doors carry a safety sign requiring isolation before entry?

blocks.zh: 5.1.6 Heating and Cooling Coils（加熱盤管與冷卻盤管）
blocks.en: 5.1.6 Heating and Cooling Coils

blocks.zh: 核心概念：盤管設計的三大平衡
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Three Balances in Coil Design

blocks.zh: 盤管（Coil）設計需要在三者之間取得平衡：
blocks.en: Coil design must balance three factors:

blocks.zh: 熱交換效率：管排數越多、鰭片越密，熱交換面積越大
blocks.en: Heat exchange efficiency: the more tube rows and the denser the fins, the larger the heat exchange area

blocks.zh: 可清潔性：排數太多（>10 排）、鰭片太密（>10 片/吋），內部難以清潔，容易滋生微生物
blocks.en: Cleanability: with too many rows (>10 rows) or fins too dense (>10 fins/inch), the interior is hard to clean and microorganisms can grow easily

blocks.zh: 壓降控制：面速度過高會增加阻力，也會把冷凝水「吹」到下游
blocks.en: Pressure drop control: excessive face velocity increases resistance and also "blows" condensate downstream

blocks.zh: Face Velocity（面速度）：空氣通過盤管正面的平均速度。冷卻盤管限制在 450 fpm 是為了防止冷凝水飛濺（Condensate Carry Over）——水滴被氣流帶到下游的濾網和風管，造成微生物風險。
blocks.en: Face Velocity: The average velocity of air across the front face of the coil. Cooling coils are limited to 450 fpm to prevent condensate carry-over, in which water droplets are carried by the airstream to downstream filters and ductwork, creating a microbial risk.

blocks.zh: 想像冷卻盤管就像淋浴後的浴室排風扇——風速太大會把水滴吹得到處都是（condensate carry over），風速太小又帶不走濕氣。450 fpm 就是那個「剛好」的平衡點。而管內水流速度 2-6 fps 也是一樣的道理——太慢沒有紊流（turbulence）導致熱交換效率差，太快則會沖蝕管壁。
blocks.en: Think of a cooling coil like a bathroom exhaust fan after a shower: if the airspeed is too high it blows water droplets everywhere (condensate carry-over), and if it is too low it cannot carry the moisture away. 450 fpm is the "just right" balance point. The same logic applies to the water velocity of 2-6 fps inside the tubes: too slow and there is no turbulence, so heat exchange is poor; too fast and the tube walls erode.

blocks.zh: 盤管規格速查 Coil Specifications
blocks.en: Coil Specifications

blocks.zh:
冷卻盤管面速度：≤ 450 fpm (2.29 m/s)
加熱盤管面速度：≤ 600 fpm (3.0 m/s)
管內水流速度：2 - 6 fps (0.61 - 1.83 m/s)

AHU 盤管銅管壁厚：0.035" (0.89 mm) 無縫銅管
AHU 盤管鋁鰭片厚度：≥ 0.0095" (0.24 mm)
風管盤管銅管壁厚：0.025" (0.64 mm)
風管盤管鋁鰭片厚度：≥ 0.008" (0.20 mm)

冷卻盤管：≤ 10 排深, ≤ 10 fins/inch
預熱盤管：≥ 2 排（減少下游溫度不均）
中心支撐：盤管寬度 > 48" (1.2 m) 時需要
框架材質：304L SS（防鏽長壽命）
blocks.en:
Cooling coil face velocity: ≤ 450 fpm (2.29 m/s)
Heating coil face velocity: ≤ 600 fpm (3.0 m/s)
Water velocity in tubes: 2 - 6 fps (0.61 - 1.83 m/s)

AHU coil copper tube wall thickness: 0.035" (0.89 mm) seamless copper tube
AHU coil aluminum fin thickness: ≥ 0.0095" (0.24 mm)
Duct coil copper tube wall thickness: 0.025" (0.64 mm)
Duct coil aluminum fin thickness: ≥ 0.008" (0.20 mm)

Cooling coil: ≤ 10 rows deep, ≤ 10 fins/inch
Preheat coil: ≥ 2 rows (reduces downstream temperature non-uniformity)
Center support: required when coil width > 48" (1.2 m)
Frame material: 304L SS (corrosion resistant, long life)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：蒸汽盤管的真空破壞器
blocks.en: Key Notes: Vacuum Breakers on Steam Coils

blocks.zh: 蒸汽盤管必須安裝 Vacuum Breaker（真空破壞器）。原因是：當蒸汽控制閥關閉時，管內殘餘蒸汽冷凝會產生真空。如果沒有真空破壞器：
blocks.en: Steam coils must be fitted with a vacuum breaker. The reason is that when the steam control valve closes, the residual steam in the tubes condenses and creates a vacuum. Without a vacuum breaker:

blocks.zh: 冷凝水無法正常排出 → 積水 → 水錘（Water Hammer）
blocks.en: Condensate cannot drain properly → standing water → water hammer

blocks.zh: 真空可能導致盤管管路變形甚至破裂
blocks.en: The vacuum can deform or even rupture the coil tubing

blocks.zh: 水錘造成劇烈震動和噪音，長期損壞管路和支架
blocks.en: Water hammer causes violent vibration and noise, and over time damages the piping and supports

blocks.zh: 此外，蒸汽必須從蒸汽主管頂部取用——底部取蒸汽會帶入冷凝水，影響加熱品質。
blocks.en: In addition, steam must be taken from the top of the steam main; taking it from the bottom carries condensate into the supply and degrades heating performance.

blocks.zh: 你的冷卻盤管面速度是否控制在 450 fpm 以內？是否曾遇到冷凝水飛濺問題？
blocks.en: Is the face velocity of your cooling coils kept within 450 fpm? Have you ever had condensate carry-over problems?

blocks.zh: 蒸汽盤管是否安裝了真空破壞器？冷凝水排放是否通暢？
blocks.en: Are the steam coils fitted with vacuum breakers? Does the condensate drain freely?

blocks.zh: 盤管的排數和鰭片密度是否符合 ISPE 建議的上限（10 排、10 fins/inch）？
blocks.en: Do the coil row count and fin density meet the upper limits recommended by ISPE (10 rows, 10 fins/inch)?

blocks.zh: 5.1.7 Steam Humidifier（蒸汽加濕器）
blocks.en: 5.1.7 Steam Humidifier

blocks.zh: 核心概念：蒸汽加濕的優勢與注意事項
blocks.en: Key Concept: Advantages and Cautions of Steam Humidification

blocks.zh: 為什麼優先使用蒸汽而非水霧？
blocks.en: Why is steam preferred over water spray?

blocks.zh: 無菌性：蒸汽本身就是無菌的（bacteria free），而水霧加濕會帶入水中的微生物
blocks.en: Sterility: Steam itself is sterile (bacteria free), whereas water-spray humidification introduces the microorganisms present in the water

blocks.zh: 可用性：製藥廠通常已有蒸汽系統，無需額外投資
blocks.en: Availability: Pharmaceutical plants usually already have a steam system, so no extra investment is needed

blocks.zh: 控制精度：調節閥可精確控制蒸汽注入量
blocks.en: Control accuracy: A modulating valve can control the amount of steam injected precisely

blocks.zh: Clean Steam vs Plant Steam：一般 HVAC 加濕使用廠用蒸汽即可。但當加濕空氣直接接觸產品（如包衣鍋、乾燥機）時，必須使用 Clean Steam（純蒸汽），並配備 316L SS 組件和衛生級三夾接頭。
blocks.en: Clean Steam vs Plant Steam: Plant steam is generally acceptable for HVAC humidification. However, when the humidified air comes into direct contact with the product (for example in coating pans or dryers), Clean Steam must be used, with 316L SS components and sanitary tri-clamp connections.

blocks.zh: 蒸汽加濕就像用蒸氣熨斗，水霧加濕則像用噴霧瓶。蒸氣熨斗出來的蒸汽是「乾淨」的（水經過加熱蒸發），但噴霧瓶直接把水霧噴出來，如果水不乾淨就會把雜質一起噴到衣服上。在製藥 HVAC 中，這個「雜質」可能是微生物——所以 ISPE 明確偏好蒸汽加濕。
blocks.en: Steam humidification is like using a steam iron, while water-spray humidification is like using a spray bottle. The steam from an iron is "clean" (the water is heated and evaporated), but a spray bottle sprays the water out directly, and if the water is not clean the impurities are sprayed onto the clothes as well. In pharmaceutical HVAC, those "impurities" may be microorganisms, which is why ISPE explicitly prefers steam humidification.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：加濕器位置有學問
blocks.en: Key Notes: Humidifier Location Matters

blocks.zh: 加濕器應放在冷卻盤管的上游，原因是：
blocks.en: The humidifier should be placed upstream of the cooling coil, for these reasons:

blocks.zh: 冬天需要加濕時，冷卻盤管通常關閉，所以不會干擾
blocks.en: When humidification is needed in winter, the cooling coil is usually off, so there is no interference

blocks.zh: 夏天不需加濕，冷卻盤管開啟進行除濕
blocks.en: In summer humidification is not needed, and the cooling coil is on to dehumidify

blocks.zh: 加濕器上游的空間提供蒸汽充分吸收的距離
blocks.en: The space upstream of the humidifier provides the distance needed for the steam to be fully absorbed

blocks.zh: 高限濕度感測器（RH > 85% 即關閉）：這是安全保護機制。如果蒸汽吸收不完全，過量的水分會凝結在下游的濾網和表面上，造成微生物風險和濾網損壞。
blocks.en: High-limit humidity sensor (shuts off at RH > 85%): This is a safety protection mechanism. If the steam is not fully absorbed, excess moisture will condense on downstream filters and surfaces, creating a microbial risk and damaging the filters.

blocks.zh: 風管內加濕的 304L SS 要求：上游 0.6m、下游 1.5m 必須使用全焊接 304L 不鏽鋼——因為蒸汽冷凝區域的腐蝕性極強。
blocks.en: 304L SS requirement for in-duct humidification: Fully welded 304L stainless steel must be used for 0.6 m upstream and 1.5 m downstream, because the steam condensation zone is extremely corrosive.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 HVAC 加濕系統使用蒸汽還是水霧？是 Plant Steam 還是 Clean Steam？
blocks.en: Does your plant's HVAC humidification system use steam or water spray? Is it Plant Steam or Clean Steam?

blocks.zh: 加濕器是否位於冷卻盤管上游？是否安裝了高限濕度感測器？
blocks.en: Is the humidifier located upstream of the cooling coil? Is a high-limit humidity sensor installed?

blocks.zh: 如果有風管內加濕，風管材質是否為全焊接 304L SS？
blocks.en: If you have in-duct humidification, is the ductwork fully welded 304L SS?

blocks.zh: 5.1.8 Dehumidification（除濕）
blocks.en: 5.1.8 Dehumidification

blocks.zh: 四種除濕技術就像四種「除濕策略」：
blocks.en: The four dehumidification technologies are like four different "dehumidification strategies":

blocks.zh: Run-around Coil：像把冷氣吹出的冷風先用來預冷新鮮空氣，再把預冷時「搶來的熱」拿去加熱出風口——左手倒右手，省下再加熱的錢
blocks.en: Run-around Coil: Like using the cold air blown from an air conditioner to pre-cool the fresh air first, then using the heat "taken" during pre-cooling to reheat the supply air. It is moving heat from one hand to the other, saving the cost of reheating

blocks.zh: Heat Pipe：像一根兩頭溫差自動導熱的「魔法棒」，冷端吸熱、熱端放熱，完全自動不用電
blocks.en: Heat Pipe: Like a "magic wand" that conducts heat automatically across the temperature difference between its two ends: the cold end absorbs heat and the hot end releases it, fully automatically with no electricity

blocks.zh: Dual Path：像餐廳的兩條動線——外送（外氣）走專用通道重點除濕，內用（回風）走另一條只降溫
blocks.en: Dual Path: Like the two traffic flows in a restaurant: takeaway orders (outside air) go through a dedicated channel for intensive dehumidification, while dine-in guests (return air) go through another path that only cools

blocks.zh: Desiccant：像在門口放一盆「超強除濕劑」，空氣經過就把水分吸走，然後定期用熱風把吸飽的水蒸出來（再生）
blocks.en: Desiccant: Like placing a basin of "super dehumidifier" at the door: air passing through has its moisture removed, and the saturated desiccant is then periodically heated with hot air to drive the water out (regeneration)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：乾燥劑系統的關鍵注意事項
blocks.en: Key Notes: Critical Points for Desiccant Systems

blocks.zh: Absorbent vs Adsorbent：吸收劑（如 LiCl）吸水後會變液態，如果不及時再生會「自毀」；吸附劑（如 Silica Gel）不會改變物理狀態，更穩定
blocks.en: Absorbent vs Adsorbent: An absorbent (such as LiCl) turns liquid after absorbing water and will "destroy itself" if not regenerated in time; an adsorbent (such as silica gel) does not change physical state and is more stable

blocks.zh: 乾燥輪必須在終端濾網上游：可能掉落的乾燥劑顆粒會被濾網攔截
blocks.en: The desiccant wheel must be upstream of the terminal filters: Any desiccant particles that may be shed will be caught by the filters

blocks.zh: 閒置時不能讓輪停轉：即使不除濕（冬天），也要保持輪轉動和再生加熱，否則吸收型乾燥劑會吸水過多而損壞
blocks.en: The wheel must not be stopped when idle: Even when no dehumidification is needed (winter), the wheel must keep rotating and regeneration heating must be maintained; otherwise an absorbent desiccant will take up too much water and be damaged

blocks.zh: 再生溫度通常 > 250°F (122°C)：需要穩定的熱源供應
blocks.en: Regeneration temperature is usually > 250°F (122°C): A stable heat source is required

blocks.zh: 乾燥輪壽命：至少 5 年維持接近 100% 的除濕能力
blocks.en: Desiccant wheel life: at least 5 years maintaining close to 100% dehumidification capacity

blocks.zh: 密封壽命：最少 25,000 小時（約 2.85 年連續運轉）
blocks.en: Seal life: at least 25,000 hours (about 2.85 years of continuous operation)

blocks.zh: 重點提示：結冰風險
blocks.en: Key Notes: Icing Risk

blocks.zh: Heat Pipe 和 Dual Path 系統在目標露點低於 32°F (0°C) 時，冷卻盤管表面會結冰。解決方案是安裝並聯的雙盤管加風門切換——一組結冰時切換到另一組，讓結冰的盤管融冰。這在需要極低濕度的製藥應用（如粉末製劑、吸入劑）中很常見。
blocks.en: With Heat Pipe and Dual Path systems, ice forms on the cooling coil surface when the target dew point is below 32°F (0°C). The solution is to install parallel dual coils with damper changeover: when one coil ices up, switch to the other and let the iced coil defrost. This is common in pharmaceutical applications that need very low humidity (such as powder formulations and inhalation products).

blocks.zh: 除濕系統規格 Dehumidification Specs
blocks.en: Dehumidification System Specs

blocks.zh:
乾燥劑系統適用露點：≤ 37°F (3°C)
密封承壓：最大 8" wg (1.99 kPa) 壓差
再生溫度：通常 > 250°F (122°C)
密封壽命：≥ 25,000 小時
乾燥輪壽命：≥ 5 年（接近 100% 能力）
箱體材質：加工硬化鋁（strain-hardened aluminum）

尖峰負荷設計注意：
  - 最高溫日 ≠ 最高濕日（通常不同時發生）
  - 尖峰負荷僅約佔運轉時間的 2%
  → 部分負載效率更重要！
blocks.en:
Desiccant system applicable dew point: ≤ 37°F (3°C)
Seal pressure rating: maximum 8" wg (1.99 kPa) differential pressure
Regeneration temperature: usually > 250°F (122°C)
Seal life: ≥ 25,000 hours
Desiccant wheel life: ≥ 5 years (close to 100% capacity)
Casing material: strain-hardened aluminum

Peak load design notes:
  - The hottest day ≠ the most humid day (they usually do not occur together)
  - Peak load accounts for only about 2% of operating time
  → Part-load efficiency matters more!

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 中，產品特性往往決定了除濕需求：
blocks.en: In a CDMO, product characteristics often determine the dehumidification requirement:

blocks.zh: 口服固體劑型（OSD）：低濕度環境（通常 RH < 30%）對粉末流動性和穩定性至關重要 → 乾燥劑系統是首選
blocks.en: Oral solid dosage (OSD): A low-humidity environment (typically RH < 30%) is critical for powder flow and stability → desiccant systems are the first choice

blocks.zh: 無菌液態製劑：通常只需要標準冷卻除濕 → Run-around 或 Heat Pipe 即可
blocks.en: Sterile liquid products: Usually only standard cooling dehumidification is needed → Run-around or Heat Pipe is sufficient

blocks.zh: 吸入劑：極低濕度需求（RH < 15%）→ 乾燥劑系統必備
blocks.en: Inhalation products: Very low humidity requirement (RH < 15%) → a desiccant system is essential

blocks.zh: 選型時務必進行全生命週期成本分析——乾燥劑系統初始投資較高，但如果有廉價蒸汽或廢熱可用於再生，長期運行成本可能更低。
blocks.en: Always carry out a life cycle cost analysis when selecting: a desiccant system has a higher initial investment, but if cheap steam or waste heat is available for regeneration, the long-term running cost can be lower.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠哪些區域需要低濕度控制？目前使用什麼除濕技術？
blocks.en: Which areas of your plant require low-humidity control? What dehumidification technology is currently used?

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑系統的再生熱源是什麼？是否有利用廢熱的可能？
blocks.en: What is the regeneration heat source for your desiccant system? Is it possible to use waste heat?

blocks.zh: 是否有區域的露點需求低於 0°C？是否有防結冰的並聯盤管設計？
blocks.en: Are there areas with a dew point requirement below 0°C? Is there a parallel-coil design to prevent icing?

blocks.zh: 尖峰負荷和部分負荷的能效表現是否都有考慮？
blocks.en: Has the energy performance at both peak load and part load been considered?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：四種除濕技術比較
blocks.en: Key Concept: Comparison of the Four Dehumidification Technologies

blocks.zh: ISPE 介紹了四種除濕系統，適用場景各不相同：
blocks.en: ISPE describes four dehumidification systems, each suited to different scenarios:

blocks.zh: 5.1.9 Ductwork Design（風管設計）
blocks.en: 5.1.9 Ductwork Design

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風管設計的 GMP 原則
blocks.en: Key Concept: GMP Principles for Ductwork Design

blocks.zh: Ductwork（風管）：將調節空氣從 AHU 輸送到各潔淨空間的管路系統。看似簡單，但風管設計直接影響系統效能和 GMP 合規：
blocks.en: Ductwork: The piping system that carries conditioned air from the AHU to each clean space. It looks simple, but ductwork design directly affects system performance and GMP compliance:

blocks.zh: 內部不得有保溫材料：暴露的保溫材料會產生微粒和黴菌生長基地
blocks.en: No insulation inside the duct: Exposed insulation generates particles and provides a breeding ground for mold

blocks.zh: 材質選擇：一般用鍍鋅鋼板，潔淨室內用不鏽鋼
blocks.en: Material selection: Galvanized steel is generally used, and stainless steel inside cleanrooms

blocks.zh: 軟管長度限制：≤ 3m，軟管壁不平整易積塵
blocks.en: Flexible duct length limit: ≤ 3 m; the uneven walls of flexible duct collect dust easily

blocks.zh: 風管就像城市的自來水管網——管路的密封性決定有多少「好空氣」真正送到目的地。1% 的洩漏限制就像要求水管漏水率不超過 1%。而「System Effect」就像水管突然轉 90 度直角彎——水壓會大幅損失，效率下降。所以風管離開風扇後要盡量保持直線。
blocks.en: Ductwork is like a city's water supply network: the tightness of the pipes determines how much "good air" actually reaches its destination. The 1% leakage limit is like requiring that a water pipe leak no more than 1%. And "System Effect" is like a water pipe suddenly turning through a 90-degree elbow: water pressure is greatly lost and efficiency drops. So after leaving the fan, ductwork should be kept as straight as possible.

blocks.zh: 風管規格要求 Ductwork Specs
blocks.en: Ductwork Specs

blocks.zh:
一般風管洩漏率：≤ 1%
正壓排氣風管/危險物質風管：0% 洩漏
最低靜壓等級：4" wg (1 kPa)
密封等級：SMACNA Seal Class A
軟管最大長度：10 ft (3 m)
密封劑標準：NFPA 255 或 UL 723
blocks.en:
General ductwork leakage: ≤ 1%
Positive-pressure exhaust ductwork / hazardous material ductwork: 0% leakage
Minimum static pressure class: 4" wg (1 kPa)
Sealing class: SMACNA Seal Class A
Maximum flexible duct length: 10 ft (3 m)
Sealant standard: NFPA 255 or UL 723

blocks.zh: 正壓排氣風管必須零洩漏：如果排氣風管（含有有害物質或化學品蒸氣）在正壓段洩漏，有害物質會擴散到機房或天花板空間——這是人員安全和交叉污染的重大風險。
blocks.en: Positive-pressure exhaust ductwork must have zero leakage: If exhaust ductwork (carrying hazardous substances or chemical vapors) leaks in a positive-pressure section, the hazardous substances will spread into the equipment room or ceiling space, which is a major risk for personnel safety and cross-contamination.

blocks.zh: 密封劑的長期耐久性：密封劑必須確保長期附著在鍍鋅鋼板上。水性密封劑容易施工但可能附著力不足，溶劑型密封劑較難施工但長期表現更好。這是一個「安裝方便 vs 長期可靠」的取捨。
blocks.en: Long-term durability of sealant: The sealant must stay bonded to the galvanized steel over the long term. Water-based sealants are easy to apply but may have inadequate adhesion; solvent-based sealants are harder to apply but perform better in the long run. This is a trade-off between "ease of installation" and "long-term reliability".

blocks.zh: 你的工廠風管系統是否進行過洩漏測試？洩漏率是多少？
blocks.en: Has your plant's ductwork system been leak tested? What is the leakage rate?

blocks.zh: 潔淨室內的風管是否使用不鏽鋼？軟管長度是否控制在 3m 以內？
blocks.en: Is stainless steel ductwork used inside the cleanrooms? Is the flexible duct length kept within 3 m?

blocks.zh: 5.1.10 Dampers and Louvers（風門與百葉窗）
blocks.en: 5.1.10 Dampers and Louvers

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風門類型與選用原則
blocks.en: Key Concept: Damper Types and Selection Principles

blocks.zh: Damper（風門）：控制風量和風向的關鍵元件。兩種基本類型：
blocks.en: Damper: A key component for controlling airflow and air direction. There are two basic types:

blocks.zh: Opposed Blade（對開式）：相鄰葉片反向旋轉 → 流量控制更線性、紊流更小 → 適合風量調節
blocks.en: Opposed Blade: Adjacent blades rotate in opposite directions → more linear flow control and less turbulence → suited to airflow modulation

blocks.zh: Parallel Blade（平行式）：所有葉片同向旋轉 → 氣流偏轉效果好 → 適合混合應用
blocks.en: Parallel Blade: All blades rotate in the same direction → good air deflection → suited to mixing applications

blocks.zh: Louver（百葉窗）：固定式進氣口裝置。設計重點是防止雨水和異物進入系統。
blocks.en: Louver: A fixed air intake device. The design focus is to prevent rain and foreign objects from entering the system.

blocks.zh: Opposed Blade 風門就像兩扇反向交叉的百葉窗——空氣被「剪切」成均勻的薄片，流量控制很平滑。Parallel Blade 風門就像所有葉片一起打方向盤——空氣被偏向一側，適合讓兩股氣流「撞」在一起混合。用錯場景就像在需要精確控溫的地方裝了一個只能「大火或小火」的開關。
blocks.en: An opposed blade damper is like two sets of shutters crossing in opposite directions: the air is "sliced" into even thin sheets and flow control is very smooth. A parallel blade damper is like all the blades turning the steering wheel together: the air is deflected to one side, which suits making two airstreams "collide" and mix. Using the wrong one is like installing a switch that offers only "high flame or low flame" where precise temperature control is needed.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：進氣口位置是 IAQ 的第一道防線
blocks.en: Key Notes: The Intake Location Is the First Line of Defense for IAQ

blocks.zh: 進氣口位置的選擇直接影響室內空氣品質。必須遠離：
blocks.en: The choice of intake location directly affects indoor air quality. It must be kept away from:

blocks.zh: 排氣煙囪和排風口
blocks.en: Exhaust stacks and exhaust outlets

blocks.zh: 污水排氣管
blocks.en: Sewage vent pipes

blocks.zh: 冷卻水塔（Legionella 風險）
blocks.en: Cooling towers (Legionella risk)

blocks.zh: 卡車裝卸區（柴油廢氣）
blocks.en: Truck loading docks (diesel exhaust)

blocks.zh: 百葉窗最大進氣速度 500 fpm (3.05 m/s) 是為了防止雨水被吸入。暴風雨百葉窗（Storm Louver）是對極端天氣的額外防護。
blocks.en: The maximum louver intake velocity of 500 fpm (3.05 m/s) is intended to prevent rain from being drawn in. Storm louvers provide extra protection against extreme weather.

blocks.zh: 低洩漏風門密封：密封條必須「機械固定」而非「黏貼」——黏膠會老化脫落，機械固定（螺絲/卡扣）更可靠持久。
blocks.en: Low-leakage damper seals: Seals must be "mechanically fastened" rather than "glued": adhesive ages and peels off, whereas mechanical fastening (screws/clips) is more reliable and durable.

blocks.zh: 風門與百葉窗規格 Damper/Louver Specs
blocks.en: Damper/Louver Specs

blocks.zh:
百葉窗最大進氣速度：500 fpm (3.05 m/s)
雪區鵝頸進氣口速度：200 fpm (1.02 m/s)
風門材質：鋁或 304 SS
百葉窗材質：陽極處理鋁或 SS + 304 SS 五金件
防鳥網：304 SS
密封方式：機械固定乙烯基密封條（非黏貼）
blocks.en:
Maximum louver intake velocity: 500 fpm (3.05 m/s)
Gooseneck intake velocity in snow regions: 200 fpm (1.02 m/s)
Damper material: aluminum or 304 SS
Louver material: anodized aluminum or SS + 304 SS hardware
Bird screen: 304 SS
Sealing method: mechanically fastened vinyl seals (not glued)

blocks.zh: 你的工廠外氣進氣口距離排氣口、冷卻水塔和卡車通道有多遠？是否符合法規最小距離？
blocks.en: How far are your plant's outside air intakes from exhaust outlets, cooling towers and truck routes? Do they meet the minimum distances required by regulations?

blocks.zh: 風量調節風門是 Opposed Blade 還是 Parallel Blade？是否選用正確？
blocks.en: Are the airflow modulating dampers opposed blade or parallel blade? Has the correct type been selected?

blocks.zh: 系統停機時，外氣和排氣風門的洩漏情況如何？密封條是否完好？
blocks.en: When the system is shut down, how much do the outside air and exhaust dampers leak? Are the seals intact?

blocks.zh: 5.1.11 Diffusers and Registers（散流器與出風口）
blocks.en: 5.1.11 Diffusers and Registers

blocks.zh: 核心概念：氣流分佈的品質關鍵
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Key to Air Distribution Quality

blocks.zh: Sweeping Action（掃流作用）：理想的氣流模式是從供氣側到回風側形成均勻的「掃過」效果，帶走微粒和污染物。這是潔淨室設計的核心原則之一。
blocks.en: Sweeping Action: The ideal airflow pattern is a uniform "sweeping" effect from the supply side to the return side, carrying away particles and contaminants. This is one of the core principles of cleanroom design.

blocks.zh: Dead Zone（死角區）：氣流覆蓋不到的區域。微粒會在死角累積，使局部潔淨度超標。解決方法：增加散流器數量，降低單點風量。
blocks.en: Dead Zone: An area the airflow does not reach. Particles accumulate in dead zones and can push local cleanliness out of limits. The remedy is to increase the number of diffusers and reduce the airflow at each point.

blocks.zh: 「多點低流量」優於「單點大流量」：這是一個非常實用的設計原則。大流量出風口會產生湍流，反而攪動微粒；多點低流量則能形成穩定的層流效果。
blocks.en: "Many points, low flow" is better than "single point, high flow": This is a very practical design principle. A high-flow outlet creates turbulence that stirs up particles, whereas many low-flow points can form a stable laminar-type flow.

blocks.zh: 想像在一個房間裡清掃灰塵——用一把超大的高壓風槍對著一個方向吹，灰塵會到處飛揚（湍流）。但如果用多把小風扇，從天花板到地板形成均勻的「空氣瀑布」，灰塵就會被平穩地帶到回風口排出。這就是「多點低流量」的道理。
blocks.en: Imagine sweeping dust in a room: if you aim one very large high-pressure air gun in one direction, dust flies everywhere (turbulence). But if you use several small fans to create an even "waterfall of air" from ceiling to floor, the dust is carried steadily to the return and removed. That is the principle of "many points, low flow".

blocks.zh: Terminal Filtration Module（末端過濾模組）配合 HEPA 濾網，不僅供應潔淨空氣，還有一個容易被忽略的功能：當 AHU 停機時防止房間內的污染空氣回流到風管系統。這對於多產品 CDMO 廠房特別重要——如果一條產線的污染物通過風管系統擴散到另一條產線，就是交叉污染事故。
blocks.en: A Terminal Filtration Module with a HEPA filter not only supplies clean air but also has an easily overlooked function: when the AHU is shut down it prevents contaminated air in the room from flowing back into the duct system. This is especially important in a multi-product CDMO facility: if contaminants from one production line spread through the duct system to another line, that is a cross-contamination incident.

blocks.zh: 你的潔淨室是否存在「死角區」？是否做過煙霧測試（Smoke Study）來驗證氣流模式？
blocks.en: Does your cleanroom have any "dead zones"? Have you performed a smoke study to verify the airflow pattern?

blocks.zh: 散流器和出風口的材質是否為不鏽鋼？清洗後是否有鏽蝕現象？
blocks.en: Are the diffusers and registers made of stainless steel? Is there any corrosion after cleaning?

blocks.zh: 5.1.12 Ultraviolet (UV) Light（紫外線燈）
blocks.en: 5.1.12 Ultraviolet (UV) Light

blocks.zh: 核心概念：UV 燈的雙重效益
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Dual Benefits of UV Lamps

blocks.zh: UV 燈（紫外線殺菌燈）：安裝在冷卻盤管附近，有兩個好處：
blocks.en: UV lamps (ultraviolet germicidal lamps): Installed near the cooling coil, they have two benefits:

blocks.zh: 微生物控制：抑制盤管表面的黴菌和細菌生長
blocks.en: Microbial control: Inhibits mold and bacterial growth on the coil surface

blocks.zh: 能效維護：防止生物膜（biofilm）附著導致熱交換效率下降
blocks.en: Energy efficiency maintenance: Prevents biofilm from attaching and degrading heat exchange efficiency

blocks.zh: 重點提示：安全連鎖
blocks.en: Key Notes: Safety Interlock

blocks.zh: UV 燈對人體有害（皮膚灼傷、眼角膜損傷），因此必須設置安全連鎖——當 AHU 門打開時，UV 電源必須自動斷電。這是一個不可妥協的安全設計。ISPE 在 2009 年稱 UV 為「emerging technology」，如今已經在許多現代製藥廠廣泛應用。
blocks.en: UV light is harmful to people (skin burns, corneal damage), so a safety interlock must be provided: when the AHU door is opened, the UV power must be cut automatically. This is a non-negotiable safety design. ISPE called UV an "emerging technology" in 2009, and it has since been widely adopted in many modern pharmaceutical plants.

blocks.zh: 你的工廠 AHU 是否安裝了 UV 燈？是否有門連鎖安全設計？
blocks.en: Are UV lamps installed in your plant's AHUs? Is there a door interlock safety design?

blocks.zh: 冷卻盤管是否有生物膜（biofilm）問題？UV 燈是否能改善？
blocks.en: Do the cooling coils have a biofilm problem? Could UV lamps improve it?

blocks.zh: 5.1.13 Fume Exhaust/Extract System Design（排氣系統設計）
blocks.en: 5.1.13 Fume Exhaust/Extract System Design

blocks.zh: 核心概念：三種污染控制策略
blocks.en: Key Concept: Three Contaminant Control Strategies

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出三種控制空氣中污染物的方法，由弱到強：
blocks.en: ISPE lists three methods of controlling airborne contaminants, from weakest to strongest:

blocks.zh: 稀釋通風（Dilution Ventilation）：用大量新鮮空氣「稀釋」污染物濃度。成本高、效率低，但設計簡單
blocks.en: Dilution Ventilation: Uses large volumes of fresh air to "dilute" the contaminant concentration. High cost and low efficiency, but simple to design

blocks.zh: 局部排氣（LEV, Local Exhaust Ventilation）：在污染物產生點直接抽走。效率高、風量小、成本低
blocks.en: Local Exhaust Ventilation (LEV): Extracts the contaminant directly at the point of generation. High efficiency, low airflow and low cost

blocks.zh: 製程內密封（Containment）：污染物從未離開設備。最理想但設備成本最高
blocks.en: Containment in the process: The contaminant never leaves the equipment. The ideal solution, but with the highest equipment cost

blocks.zh: Capture Velocity（捕獲速度）：排氣罩口需要的最低氣流速度，確保能「抓住」飛散的微粒。粒子越重、飛散速度越快，所需的捕獲速度就越高。
blocks.en: Capture Velocity: The minimum air velocity required at the hood opening to ensure airborne particles are "captured". The heavier the particles and the faster they are thrown off, the higher the capture velocity required.

blocks.zh: 三種方法的差異就像處理廚房油煙：
blocks.en: The three methods differ like ways of handling kitchen cooking fumes:

blocks.zh: 稀釋通風：打開所有窗戶讓油煙散開（整棟房子都聞得到味道）
blocks.en: Dilution ventilation: Open all the windows to let the fumes disperse (the whole house smells of it)

blocks.zh: LEV：在炒菜鍋上方安裝抽油煙機（油煙一產生就被吸走）
blocks.en: LEV: Install a range hood above the wok (the fumes are pulled away as soon as they are produced)

blocks.zh: Containment：用密封的電磁爐+密封鍋蓋（油煙根本不會產生）
blocks.en: Containment: Use a sealed induction cooker with a sealed lid (no fumes are produced at all)

blocks.zh: 製藥業的「抽油煙機」（LEV）必須在排出前加一個 HEPA 濾網——就像讓油煙通過活性碳濾網再排出，確保不會污染環境。
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical "range hood" (LEV) must have a HEPA filter added before discharge, just like passing the fumes through an activated carbon filter before release, to ensure the environment is not contaminated.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：粉塵收集系統的安全設計
blocks.en: Key Notes: Safety Design of Dust Collection Systems

blocks.zh: 粉塵收集系統有爆炸風險——許多製藥粉末（如乳糖、API）在特定濃度下是可燃的。安全設計要點：
blocks.en: Dust collection systems carry an explosion risk: many pharmaceutical powders (such as lactose and APIs) are combustible at certain concentrations. Key safety design points:

blocks.zh: 風管必須接地（防靜電引燃）
blocks.en: Ductwork must be grounded (to prevent ignition by static electricity)

blocks.zh: 集塵器需配備防爆洩壓口
blocks.en: Dust collectors must be fitted with explosion relief vents

blocks.zh: 集塵器最好設在建築外部獨立空間
blocks.en: Dust collectors are best located in a separate space outside the building

blocks.zh: 若在建築內：需靠外牆 + 直通外部排氣管 ≤ 3m + 防爆洩壓
blocks.en: If inside the building: they must be on an exterior wall + a direct exhaust duct to the outside ≤ 3 m + explosion relief

blocks.zh: 或安裝爆炸抑制系統（適合無法靠外牆的情況）
blocks.en: Or install an explosion suppression system (suitable where an exterior wall location is not possible)

blocks.zh: 使用 Bag-in/Bag-out（袋進袋出）安全換袋設計
blocks.en: Use a Bag-in/Bag-out safe bag change design

blocks.zh: 自清洗集塵器的壓差影響：反向吹掃清灰時，瞬間風量下降可能影響房間壓差——這在 GMP 製造區是嚴重問題。設計和調試時必須評估這個效應。
blocks.en: Pressure differential effect of self-cleaning dust collectors: During reverse-pulse cleaning, the momentary drop in airflow can affect room pressure differentials, which is a serious problem in GMP manufacturing areas. This effect must be evaluated during design and commissioning.

blocks.zh: 排氣規格 Exhaust Specifications
blocks.en: Exhaust Specifications

blocks.zh:
排氣煙囪最低排放速度：≥ 3,000 fpm (15.24 m/s)
（適用於含污染物的排氣）

最低輸送速度（依污染物類型）：
  氣體：無最低限制
  蒸氣/煙/燻氣：10 m/s (2,000 fpm)
  輕/中密度粉塵：15 m/s (3,000 fpm)
  一般密度粉塵：20 m/s (4,000 fpm)
  重/濕粉塵：25 m/s (5,000 fpm)

HEPA「警察」濾網：排放到大氣前的最終防線
  → 換濾網時必須做洩漏測試
  → 至少每年測試一次
blocks.en:
Minimum exhaust stack discharge velocity: ≥ 3,000 fpm (15.24 m/s)
(applies to exhaust containing contaminants)

Minimum conveying velocity (by contaminant type):
  Gases: no minimum
  Vapors/smoke/fumes: 10 m/s (2,000 fpm)
  Light/medium-density dust: 15 m/s (3,000 fpm)
  Average-density dust: 20 m/s (4,000 fpm)
  Heavy/moist dust: 25 m/s (5,000 fpm)

HEPA "police" filter: the final line of defense before discharge to atmosphere
  → Leak test required when the filter is changed
  → Tested at least once a year

blocks.zh: 重點提示：集中式 vs 獨立式排氣系統
blocks.en: Key Notes: Manifolded vs Independent Exhaust Systems

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確偏好集中式（Manifolded）排氣系統，因為：
blocks.en: ISPE explicitly prefers manifolded exhaust systems, because:

blocks.zh: 風扇冗餘：N+1 配置，一台故障不影響運行
blocks.en: Fan redundancy: N+1 configuration, so one failure does not affect operation

blocks.zh: 維護成本更低
blocks.en: Lower maintenance cost

blocks.zh: 能源效率更高
blocks.en: Higher energy efficiency

blocks.zh: 但當排氣物質相互不相容（如酸性和鹼性蒸氣）或排氣點位置分散時，獨立風扇是合理的選擇。
blocks.en: However, when the exhausted substances are incompatible with each other (such as acidic and alkaline vapors) or the exhaust points are widely dispersed, independent fans are a reasonable choice.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，多產品共線意味著集塵系統可能處理不同 API 的粉塵。關鍵考量：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, multi-product shared lines mean that a dust collection system may handle the dust of different APIs. Key considerations:

blocks.zh: 交叉污染：不同產品的集塵器是否完全隔離？
blocks.en: Cross-contamination: Are the dust collectors for different products completely segregated?

blocks.zh: 產品更換：換產品時集塵風管如何清潔驗證？
blocks.en: Product changeover: How is the dust collection ductwork cleaned and the cleaning validated at product changeover?

blocks.zh: OEL 考量：高活性藥物的粉塵收集需要更嚴格的密封和 HEPA 過濾
blocks.en: OEL considerations: Dust collection for highly potent drugs requires tighter containment and HEPA filtration

blocks.zh: 有效煙囪高度：是否做過風洞模擬確認排氣不會被進氣口吸入？
blocks.en: Effective stack height: Has a wind tunnel simulation been done to confirm the exhaust will not be drawn into the air intakes?

blocks.zh: 你的工廠集塵系統是集中式還是獨立式？風管是否接地？
blocks.en: Is your plant's dust collection system manifolded or independent? Is the ductwork grounded?

blocks.zh: 集塵器是否配備防爆洩壓？是否位於建築外部？
blocks.en: Are the dust collectors fitted with explosion relief? Are they located outside the building?

blocks.zh: 排氣 HEPA 濾網的洩漏測試頻率是多少？是否使用 Bag-in/Bag-out 系統？
blocks.en: How often are the exhaust HEPA filters leak tested? Is a Bag-in/Bag-out system used?

blocks.zh: 自清洗集塵器的反吹週期是否會造成房間壓差波動？
blocks.en: Could the reverse-pulse cycle of self-cleaning dust collectors cause fluctuations in room pressure differential?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 設備選型核心原則：以全生命週期成本（Life Cycle Cost）為基準，而非初始採購價格。「Off the shelf」設備在經濟分析支持下可以接受，關鍵是滿足 User Requirements
blocks.en: Core principle of equipment selection: Base decisions on life cycle cost, not initial purchase price. "Off the shelf" equipment is acceptable when supported by economic analysis; the key is to meet the User Requirements

blocks.zh: AHU 箱體設計：115% 容量餘裕、隔熱斷橋防凝結、304L SS 防腐蝕、洩漏率 ≤ 0.5%、門逆壓開啟且內部有安全把手
blocks.en: AHU casing design: 115% capacity margin, thermal break against condensation, 304L SS for corrosion resistance, leakage ≤ 0.5%, doors opening against pressure with an interior safety handle

blocks.zh: 風扇是最關鍵的機械組件：軸承失效是最常見故障（ABMA L10 ≥ 200,000 hr）、Fan Wall 提供冗餘和節能、振動監測 BV-4 等級、RPM ≤ 1800
blocks.en: The fan is the most critical mechanical component: bearing failure is the most common fault (ABMA L10 ≥ 200,000 hr), a fan wall provides redundancy and energy saving, vibration monitoring to BV-4 grade, RPM ≤ 1800

blocks.zh: VFD 是標配：精確風量控制、顯著節能（功率 ∝ 轉速³）、必須解決軸接地問題防止電蝕
blocks.en: The VFD is standard: precise airflow control, significant energy saving (power ∝ speed³), and shaft grounding must be addressed to prevent electrical erosion

blocks.zh: 盤管設計平衡三要素：熱交換效率 vs 可清潔性 vs 壓降控制。冷卻盤管面速度 ≤ 450 fpm、≤ 10 排、≤ 10 fins/inch
blocks.en: Coil design balances three factors: heat exchange efficiency vs cleanability vs pressure drop control. Cooling coil face velocity ≤ 450 fpm, ≤ 10 rows, ≤ 10 fins/inch

blocks.zh: 蒸汽加濕優先：因為無菌且可用。加濕器放在冷卻盤管上游，高限 RH 85% 自動關閉
blocks.en: Steam humidification first: because it is sterile and available. Place the humidifier upstream of the cooling coil, with automatic shut-off at a high limit of 85% RH

blocks.zh: 四種除濕技術各有適用場景：Run-around（能效）、Heat Pipe（免維護）、Dual Path（精確控制）、Desiccant（極低露點 ≤ 3°C）
blocks.en: Each of the four dehumidification technologies has its own application: Run-around (energy efficiency), Heat Pipe (maintenance-free), Dual Path (precise control), Desiccant (very low dew point ≤ 3°C)

blocks.zh: 風管密封至關重要：一般 ≤ 1% 洩漏、正壓危險物質風管零洩漏、SMACNA Seal Class A
blocks.en: Duct sealing is critical: generally ≤ 1% leakage, zero leakage for positive-pressure hazardous material ductwork, SMACNA Seal Class A

blocks.zh: 風門選型：風量調節用 Opposed Blade、混合用 Parallel Blade。百葉窗進氣 ≤ 500 fpm，遠離排氣/冷卻水塔/卡車區
blocks.en: Damper selection: Opposed Blade for airflow modulation, Parallel Blade for mixing. Louver intake ≤ 500 fpm, kept away from exhausts, cooling towers and truck areas

blocks.zh: 排氣系統安全：集塵器必須防爆、接地、最好在建築外。排氣速度 ≥ 3,000 fpm。集中式排氣系統提供冗餘，優於獨立式
blocks.en: Exhaust system safety: dust collectors must be explosion protected, grounded and preferably located outside the building. Exhaust velocity ≥ 3,000 fpm. A manifolded exhaust system provides redundancy and is preferable to independent systems
